steps.name: CREATE_RUN
steps.does: create a new QTO run/version id; record the frozen inputs (source, decode, decoder pin, qualification id, unit claim id, designation id, frame id, evidence version, method hashes, baseline row versions)

steps.name: APPLY_APPROVED_REGION_AND_FRAME
steps.does: accepted designation + confirmed unit -> measurement frame (V3)

steps.name: RUN_SIX_APPROVED_METHODS
steps.does: rooms (Method A) then the six row expressions

steps.name: COMPARE_OLD_VS_NEW
steps.does: every row: canonical (rounded to published precision) vs approved baseline

steps.name: ABORT_ON_ANY_NON_APPROVED_DIFFERENCE
steps.does: any abort condition -> the run is closed ABORTED, nothing published

steps.name: HUMAN_REVIEW
steps.does: owner reviews the before/after table and provenance; approval is recorded as a claim

steps.name: PUBLISH_NEW_VERSION
steps.does: new row versions with supersession records pointing to the baseline versions

steps.name: KEEP_OLD_VERSION_UNTOUCHED
steps.does: baseline versions stay byte-identical (hash recorded before and after)

steps.name: ROLLBACK_BY_SELECTING_PREVIOUS_VERSION
steps.does: rollback = a further supersession selecting the previous version, with author and reason; never a delete or an in-place edit

abort_conditions.condition: source DWG sha256 differs from the frozen value
D1 decode sha256 differs from the frozen value
decoder binary differs from the pin, or its V2 qualification is absent / withdrawn
a round-1 observation carries a signature not EXERCISED_AND_PASS
designation id, extent or review status differs from the frozen accepted designation
frame evidence digest differs from the frozen one
unit claim id / value differs, or the claim was superseded
any file of the frozen calculation path changed
a canonical input the contract requires is missing (block names, part ids, texts, dimensions) or differs from the frozen check
any BLOCKING finding in the row region (V-CAD-5 or source exception)
canonical value rounded to the published precision differs from the approved value (tolerance 0; no widening)
a row lacks observation ids, geometry ids, frame id, evidence version, method id, formula, inputs or qualification id
a row added, removed or renamed relative to the frozen round-1 scope
a room added, removed, renamed or re-classified wet/dry relative to the frozen proof
an owner action this round depends on is not RESOLVED by an authorised claim
the version being superseded is not APPROVED

fail_closed: an abort check that cannot be evaluated (missing evidence, error) counts as triggered
never: overwrite an approved quantity in place

triggers: V-CAD-5 regression in the row region
